summary: Iteration 82 — Budget-alert EMAIL delivery pipeline + Alert Email Digest choice (instant/daily/weekly) AND full frontend regression post-Expo-SDK-57 upgrade both VERIFIED end-to-end. BACKEND: 8/8 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration82_email_digest.py against the live preview API in ~4.5s using the seeded review account (jaleter.appreview@gmail.com). Every A1..A6 item confirmed: (A1) INSTANT MODE: evaluate-budget with $1000 budget / $850 spent → category_80 notification persisted with email_status='sent', push_status='failed' (placeholder push key — expected), delivery_status='sent'. (A2) PUT emailFrequency='daily' round-trips exactly via GET /prefs; invalid value 'hourly' server-side normalizes to 'instant' (per notifications_router:82 whitelist ∈ {instant,daily,weekly}). (A3) With emailFrequency='daily', evaluate-budget → category_80 with email_status='queued', delivery_status='queued', push_status='failed' (push still attempted instantly, correct). (A4) POST /notifications/email-digest/run-now flushes queued alerts → {sent: true, count: 2} (SUB_DAILY budget + TX_DAILY tx); both flip to email_status='sent'+delivery_status='sent' server-side. Second run-now returns {skipped: 'empty'} — proves flush→sent transition is the dedupe key. (A5) evaluate-transaction ($750 with singleExpense.threshold=500) respects emailFrequency: on daily → email_status='queued' + delivery_status='queued'; switched to instant + fresh tx ($900) → email_status='sent' + push_status='failed' + delivery_status='sent'. (A6) emailFrequency reset back to 'instant' at end + prefs restored to app defaults (perCategory:{}, singleExpense:{enabled:false, threshold:200}). Cleanup: all iter82 synthetic notifications + alert_state dedupe slots deleted from review account so evaluators see a clean inbox. FRONTEND (390×844 mobile viewport, Expo web preview, SDK 57): (B1) alert-email-frequency PeriodPills with testIDs alert-email-frequency, alert-email-frequency-Instant, alert-email-frequency-Daily, alert-email-frequency-Weekly all present in Settings → Budget Alerts. Tapping Daily persists — confirmed by full page reload: after logout+login, the Daily pill has the selected white background (rgb(255,255,255)) while Instant/Weekly are transparent — proves server prefs sync path works. Restored to Instant at end. (B2) SDK 57 regression PASSES: premium login lands directly on dashboard 'Good evening, Apple.' — no Welcome flash, no paywall. All 6 bottom tabs render with testIDs nav-home, nav-budget, nav-reports, nav-transactions, nav-networth, nav-legacy (label mapping: Home / Budget / Reports / Activity / Wealth / Legacy). Icons render everywhere in the screenshots — no missing-glyph boxes on any screen (bell, profile, tab icons, chevrons, checkmarks, arrows all display correctly), confirming @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons migration works cleanly. Settings screen full-scroll works: Experience pills (Faith/Both/Motivation), Appearance (Light/System/Dark), Budget Alerts master toggle, alert-cat-toggle-give/steward/grow/enjoy, alert-single-toggle, alert-weekly-digest-toggle, alert-email-frequency, settings-applock, billing-notice-billing, settings-accounts, settings-support, settings-notifications, settings-terms, settings-privacy, settings-reset, settings-logout, settings-delete-account all present and accessible. Logout works cleanly and returns to Welcome (Get Started / Log in). ZERO console errors, ZERO pageerrors on the entire premium-account flow. (B3) UNPAID FLOW: fresh user register (via btnStart → onboarding Continue → signup-name/email/password + signup-terms checkbox → signup-create) → LANDS ON PAYWALL (not dashboard). paywall-checkout, paywall-refresh, paywall-signed-in-as, paywall-signout all present. 'Signed in as iter82_...@example.com' footer visible, 'Not you? Sign out' button (paywall-signout) present. The three 402 console messages during paywall render are EXPECTED (unpaid member calling membership-gated endpoints returns 402 per iteration-80 contract). Note: the review request mentions a 'More' tab but the actual app ships 6 tabs (Home/Budget/Reports/Activity/Wealth/Legacy) with no separate More — Settings is reached via home-bell icon. Not a bug, just a naming discrepancy in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: budget_alert_service.py:130-164 _emit() correctly branches push (instant always) vs email (instant now / queued for digest) and computes overall delivery_status precedence: sent (any channel succeeded) > queued (email pending) > failed. Verified by A1 (email sent + push failed → sent), A3 (email queued + push failed → queued), A4 (queued→sent after digest flush).

budget_alert_service.py:283-310 flush_user_alert_digest() atomically updates {email_status:'sent', delivery_status:'sent'} on the exact _id set that was collected pre-send. On send failure the docs stay 'queued' for the next sweep — correct retry semantics. Note: this predicate ordering is important — if send_email raised mid-flight, docs stay queued (verified in A4 second run-now returning {skipped:'empty'}, no double-send).

budget_alert_service.py:313-351 sweep_alert_email_digests() computes user-local hour via ZoneInfo and only flushes when local hour == 18 for daily / Sunday 18h for weekly. Instant users with residual queued alerts are also flushed opportunistically — good defensive behavior for users who switch back from daily→instant with unsent queue.

notifications_router.py:56-91 PrefsBody Pydantic model + normalization at :82 whitelists emailFrequency ∈ {instant,daily,weekly}; anything else → 'instant'. Correctly verified by test A2b passing 'hourly' → server returns 'instant' both in PUT response and subsequent GET.

notifications_router.py:182-191 POST /email-digest/run-now uses per-user auth (not member_auth) so a free user could technically hit it — but flush_user_alert_digest is a no-op if the user has no queued alerts (returns {skipped:'empty'}), so this is safe by construction. FYI to main agent, not a bug.

SettingsScreen.tsx:291-293 PeriodPills mapping emailFrequency <-> 'Instant'/'Daily'/'Weekly' correctly lowercases on tap (`v.toLowerCase()`) so the value sent to server is exactly 'instant'/'daily'/'weekly'. Matches server whitelist.

rca_of_issue: N/A — main-agent implementation is complete and correct. The email-mode branching in _emit() (:147-156) is elegant: push always fires instantly (SuprSend has its own throttling); email either fires now or is stamped 'queued' for the batching sweep to consolidate into ONE digest email. This minimizes inbox noise (daily = 1 email/day covering all alerts, weekly = 1 email/week) while preserving push immediacy. The flush→sent atomic update at :305-309 is the dedupe key — a second run-now finds no queued docs and returns {skipped:'empty'} — no risk of double-sending even under scheduler concurrency (max_instances=1 in the digest sweeper). Verified end-to-end by A4 test.
